decisions.reason: Connects session/tool worker as descendant of the host npm is replacing; host dies mid-install, GUI disconnects, tool result unrecorded/unknown; explicitly rejects random-failure reading without claiming every-platform universal crash.

Explains content present but dsh/dsh.cmd missing, dsh.ps1 stale, shim layer destroyed before bin-link phase; ties non-standard tree to the broken shims and rejects hand-swapping/hand-written shims with reasons.

Grounds repair in repair-notes.md: external pinned `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1` regenerating shims, dsh --version = rc.1, checkout aligned to dsh-v0.1.2-rc.1 tag, no unrelated source edits; recorded repair vs candidate-proposed verification kept separate.

Recognizes agent runs on the upgrade target and must hand off, not execute; stop-host-first before pinned install, restart/refresh/verify; identifies stop-first and exact pinning as established rules with refusal-from-inside as the self-host increment; notes an in-host dependent shell is not a handoff.

Proposes a pre-execution self-location/target-is-self guard tied to runtime path; uses the alpha.5→rc.1 version-only diff to rule out plugin migration; checks displayed version and actual plugin loading after restart/refresh; backup cleanup only after confirmed success; scoped to the supplied tags.

caps.reason: Final advice is stop-first external pinned install from an independent shell; no in-session execution or retry recommended.
Manual swaps and hand-written shims are explicitly analyzed and rejected; the final fix is the formal external pinned reinstall.
